Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows against human single-protein target CHEMBL260 (MAPK14). Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID.
